What the twin expects (30 min, against doing nothing)
Confidence: medium (0.47). A modelled heuristic, not a probability.

then back to the current program, on its own
If no one decides, the current plan holds. Nothing changes without a
Recorded in the audit trail: R. Sen, the verb, the time, the twin run and the figures shown.
An approved change goes through the platform's signal writer (snapshot, gate, restore).
The twin itself never writes a signal.
dashed: modelled, simulated, emulated or unverified (or shown only when needed)

1 Queue, soonest first; the selected one in orange. 2 The place and what the twin expects at the focus. 3 One decision at a time. 4 The rationale an AI wrote (blue rule), in English and Bengali; it may only use the twin's numbers. 5 Twin

metrics and confidence, all modelled. 6 A named officer is required; without one the buttons stay visible but disabled ("Name yourself above to decide"). 7 Approve / Edit / Reject: Edit changes the seconds or the minutes and re-tests
them in the twin before it can be approved (design intent); Reject asks for a reason. After deciding, the sheet collapses to "Recorded with R. Sen at 12:44 IST" and "Next decision →".
